title: Your lifetime: yearly series and trends from every start year

method.trend: Mann-Kendall (Hamed-Rao 1998 variance correction when ranks show significant autocorrelation); Sen's slope with Gilbert (1987) 95% CI; the same test as Then vs Now's full-record trend
method.clear_rule: a trend is stated only if p < 0.05 and the 95% CI excludes 0
method.water: GRACE is national (Bangladesh box): the same series for every city; yearly means of the months present
